login.description: Sign in with a site operator account. Company, client and crew accounts use the regular sign-in.

dashboard.pendingHint: Company registration approvals appear here once the company-admin approval screen is merged.

search.label: Search
search.companies: Find by company name or address

company.name: Company
company.changeOwnerHint: The new owner must be a member of this company. The current owner becomes a manager.
company.quotaHint: Leave empty to use the site default. At least 0.1 GB.

user.name: Name
user.suspendBody: They can no longer sign in. Their uploads stay as they are.
user.resetLinkBody: Send this link to the person directly. It works once.
user.anonymizeBody: Removes name and contact details and blocks sign-in. Uploads and history stay. This cannot be undone.

settings.description: Set upload limits and the default storage limit for companies. Changes apply from the next upload.
settings.defaultQuotaHint: Leave empty for no limit. Set per-company limits on the company page.

cleanup.description: Remove files that only take up space and old notifications. These are the only exceptions to the no-delete rule.
cleanup.filesHint: Files rejected by checks and files not attached anywhere for 24 hours.
cleanup.notificationsHint: Notifications read more than 90 days ago are deleted every night. You can also run it now.

audit.description: Records what site admins did, such as approvals, suspensions, anonymization and owner changes.

withdraw.description: Your name and contact details are removed and you can no longer sign in. Your uploads and history stay with the company.
withdraw.soleOwnerHint: If you are the only owner of a company, ask the site admin to change the owner first.
withdraw.confirmLabel: I understand and want to delete my account.

legal.draftNotice: Draft. It will be reviewed before the service launches.

terms.s1: These terms set out the rights, duties and responsibilities between Interior Supporter (the 'Service') operator and companies, project leads, clients and crews who use it.
terms.s2: Sign-up creates a personal account. A company can be used after its registration is approved by the operator. Client and crew accounts are created by the company's project leads. You manage your own account and may not hand it to others.
terms.s3: Companies are responsible for the designs, materials, estimates, photos and other content they upload, and for the access they give to clients and crews.
terms.s4: You may not use another person's account, try to access content without permission, or disrupt the Service.
terms.s5: The operator may suspend an account or company that breaks these terms or when needed for security.
terms.s6: You may delete your account at any time. Your name and contact details are removed; records the company must keep remain with the author shown as 'Deleted user'.
terms.s7: We announce changes in the Service 7 days before they take effect.

privacy.s1: Name, email, password (stored encrypted), company name, address and business registration number (when registering a company; the number is optional), and files and records you add while using the Service.
privacy.s2: To verify accounts and sign-in, provide company and project collaboration features, respond to security incidents and keep usage records.
privacy.s3: Name and contact details are removed immediately when you delete your account. Company work records are kept with the author anonymized while the company uses the Service. Read notifications are deleted after 90 days.
privacy.s4: We do not share data with third parties except as required by law. Data is stored with cloud database and file storage providers.
privacy.s5: You can view and correct your information and delete your account. Contact the operator for anything else.
privacy.s6: Privacy contact: site operator (details to be set)

error.notMember: Only a member of this company can become its owner.
error.selfTarget: You cannot do this to your own account.
error.soleOwner: This is the only owner of a company. Change the owner first.
